description:
A leading international law firm is seeking a Corporate Paralegal to join its high-performing team in Hong Kong. This is a fantastic opportunity for a motivated legal professional to gain hands-on experience across a wide range of corporate transactions and capital markets work.

Key Responsibilities:
You’ll support lawyers on matters including:

- Hong Kong listings (IPOs and secondary offerings such as placements, rights issues, public offerings, and block trades)
- Pre-listing restructuring and financing
- Post-listing compliance
- Mergers & acquisitions

What We’re Looking For:

- Prior experience in corporate or capital markets work preferred
- Strong attention to detail and organisational skills
- Ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative team
- Fluent in English and Chinese
- A proactive mindset and eagerness to learn

To apply for the above position, please submit your resume in Word file by clicking "APPLY NOW" below or contact Joanne Goh on j.goh@alsrecruit.com for further information.
